assertion_analysis.failure_condition: More than one probe occurs in two picks, or the fixed 42% and 60% fixtures produce the wrong offered state.
The published source is not reserved-probe, the stored value differs from the fixture's used input, its stamp is undated, or the 60% refusal omits the fixed percentage; line 95 is self-comparison.
A supplied live budget view remains stale after a successful 42% probe or the candidate is excluded.
The crew pick command fails or the route criteria include Claude for the fixed 60%/unknown fixtures or exclude it for the fixed 42% fixture.
Two unknown-source picks send more or fewer than one probe, fail to say unknown or stale, invent a numeric window, or lose the failure marker; the mutation log reds line 198.
A rejected event opens the lane, publishes a numeric five-hour window, or loses the probe failure.
The subprocess builder omits tool exclusion, budget cap, model, input, or timeout, or fails to return a stream; the fake subprocess does not verify a real provider response.
A routine request invokes the reserved probe or offers Claude.
The weekly-only fixture suppresses the probe, the 42% lane is excluded, or a new probe overwrites the fixed 20% weekly reading.
A cached pick invokes the probe or opens an unknown reserved window.
Publishing drops the fixed 42% probed figure or changes the already-stored attempt marker; the comparison tests preservation, not marker correctness.
A direct refresh reports no change, an unknown view contains a figure, the refreshed view lacks fixed 42%, or its source is not the document.
